messages:
Alex C: FYI — opened the fridge and found a half-exploded jar of salsa on the middle shelf. :scream: messy but salvageable?
Maria P: Oh no. Which salsa brand? I can swing by Whole Foods on my way home if we need a replacement. :truck:
Alex C: It’s the big Trader Joe's jar. Lid popped and leaked onto the shelf and a yogurt tub :grimace:
Jamal: Ugh. I’ll be at the office for another hour, can clean it up. Do we have gloves and paper towels in the supply cabinet?
Sophie: Gloves in the top drawer by the sink. Also FYI microwave still smells like last week's curry — please cover food or use the lids. :nose:
Alex C: Thanks Jamal. If anyone has a trash bag and gloves pls bring them to the kitchen. I’ll put the leaked yogurt straight in a bag.
Maria P: I grabbed a replacement jar (mild) and put it on the counter — labeled with my name. If anyone prefers hot salsa, lemme know and I’ll take it back and get hot.
Jamal: Nice, thanks Maria. Quick poll — for future snack runs do people prefer: a) salsa + chips, b) hummus + pita, c) mixed (rotate)? React with :one: :two: :three:
Sophie: :one: for salsa
Alex C: :three: — rotate keeps it interesting
Maria P: :two: would be appreciated by our vegan folks
KitchenBot: Reminder: Fridge tidy-up scheduled Friday 10:00am. Anything left unlabeled will be dumped. :robot_face:
Jamal: Cleaned shelf, wiped with sanitizer, put a paper towel under the replaced jar. Also moved the mystery yogurt to compost. 
Alex C: Thanks Jamal! Left a short sticky note on the replaced jar: "Replaced 2239998888 — Maria P". Can we standardize a 2-line label? Suggestion:

```
Name: <first last>
Date: YYYY-MM-DD
```

Maria P: Love that. I’ll print a small stack of pre-cut labels and leave them in the drawer.
Sophie: Also — microwave etiquette reminder: cover food, set timer correctly, if you overflow wipe it then and there. Maybe a tiny sticky with that on the microwave?
Alex C: Agree. Sophie, wanna make a one-liner we can sticky? I can stick it tomorrow.
Sophie: "Cover, set to needed time, and wipe spills. Be kind to the next person :)"
Alex C: Perfect. Thx all. If anyone needs salsa tonight, help yourself. :taco:
